result_text:
I fixed the four broken default conventions in `codeanalyzer`, and the new test and the existing `SourceFileFilterTest` pass (`mvn -q -o`, no output, so no failures). Nothing is committed.

The default patterns use full-match semantics, so each typo meant the rule could never match:

- **`GeneratedConventions.java`**: the three HTML rules (pkgdown, Doxygen, meta generator) now use `.*[.](htm|html|xhtml)`. The `.NET` documentation XML rule now uses `.*[.]xml` instead of `.*/[.]xml`. The JS `// Generated by` rule now uses `.*[.]js` instead of `.*/[.]js`.
- **`BuildAndDeploymentConventions.java`**: the Gradle JavaScript rule is now `.*[-]gradle[.]js` instead of `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js`, so it matches `build-gradle.js`.
- **New `codeanalyzer/src/test/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/DefaultConventionsMatchTest.java`**: checks that `.htm` pkgdown/Doxygen/meta pages, a `MyAssembly.xml` with a `<doc>` line, a `// Generated by` `app.js` and `build-gradle.js` are matched. It also checks that `.html`, `.xhtml` and `build.gradle` still match and that hand-written `.htm`, `.js` and `.xml` files do not. The helper only considers path-specific rules, so the content-only `// Generated by` rule can't mask a broken path pattern.
